title: Ankara — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Ankara: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Ankara has a population of 5,663,000. The capital of Turkey, a modern city with government buildings, museums, and a thriving university scene. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.0.
